title: TSGenerator 2.0.0: Tools for Copernicus HR-VPP Vegetation Time-Series Processing
description: TSGenerator 2.0.0 is an open-source R package for acquiring, extracting, quality-assessing, and analysing vegetation time series derived from Copernicus High Resolution Vegetation Phenology and Productivity (HR-VPP) products. Version 2.0 provides native R access to the WEkEO Harmonised Data Access service through hdar for Seasonal Trajectories (ST) and Vegetation Phenology and Productivity (VPP) products; terra-based geospatial extraction and product-aware quality handling; temporal completeness assessment, optional imputation, and missingness diagnostics; and a unified Shiny application implementing an Acquire–Prepare/Extract–Quality–Analyze–Export workflow. Selected TSGenerator 1.x functions and historical source code are retained for migration and legacy traceability.
